text: {"lessons":["Selling stocks just because they rose quickly can cut short further gains; I should base decisions on the outlook, not my average cost or recent performance alone.","Holding a losing stock simply because it has fallen can keep me tied to a poor investment; I should reassess it objectively rather than wait to break even.","I rarely check or trade, so I should review my holdings periodically and make deliberate decisions instead of letting winners and losers drift without reassessment."]}
